title: NONSTICK DOESN'T LAST
text: NONSTICK DOESN'T LAST. I agree with all the reviewers who complained that the nonstick surface works great for a time, then deteriorates to the point of not working at all. I followed all directions, but nonetheless the pan is now next to useless. This pan is simply not worth the hefty price.

product_metadata.title: Ozeri 8" Green Ceramic Frying Pan and Lid Set, with Smooth Ceramic Non-Stick Coating (100% PTFE and PFOA Free)
features: Unlike other ceramic cookware brands, the Ozeri Green Earth Pan utilizes an ultra-safe ceramic coating inspired by nature which is 100% free of PTFE and GenX fluorinated chemicals (APEO, PFBS, PFOS, PFOA).
Delivers unprecedented non-stick performance without releasing harmful fumes or toxins at high temperatures.
Features a scratch-resistant 100 percent ceramic coating that is super easy to clean.
Made out of durable heavy-gauge die-cast aluminum with no heavy metals or harmful chemicals.
Boasts a comfortable heat-resistant Bakelight handle, and a magnetized induction stove safe base for rapid heat transfer.
Includes a tempered glass lid for improved thermal performance; oven-safe up to 320 F (160 C).
